question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**thrown away**" signifies discarding something, typically after it has served its purpose. (फेंक देना)
 
• In the context of the passage, **"thrown away"** refers to single-use plastic products that are discarded after a short period of use.
 
• The other options: "**around**" (indicating surrounding area), "**across**" (from one side to the other), and "**of**" (indicating belonging) do not fit the context as appropriately as "away".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** We are seeing other worrying trends. By the 1970s, the rate of plastic production has grown faster than that of any other material. If historic growth trends continue, global production of primary plastic is forecasted to reach 1,100 million tonnes by 2050. We have also seen a worrying shift towards single-use plastic products, items that are meant to be thrown away__ after a single short use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Around (आस-पास)**: Indicates the surrounding area or vicinity. 

 
 
• **Example:** She looked around for her keys.
 
 
 
• **Across (पार करना)**: Moving from one side to the other. 
 
 
• **Example:** They walked across the bridge.
 
 
 
• **Of (का/के)**: Indicates possession or belonging. 
 
 
• **Example:** The book of the year.
